quotes.text: In the D330263 Toggle story, the review found a text input with no label, title, or accessible name. Storybook includes an accessibility check, so this field needs a name. This was a source finding only: Storybook was not run because its node_modules directory was absent.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
